paragraphs: R' Yaakov bar Nachmani. See R' Yitzchak bar Nachmani.[^1]

notes.text: Yaakov and Yitzchak remain distinct given names, each with bar Nachmani. The notice supplies only the pointer; both abbreviated titles remain R'.
